headlines.title: Shut out of meeting, Zelenskyy says what he would say to Trump, Xi and Putin
headlines.description: Ahead of Trump's meeting with Presidents Putin and Xi, Zelenskyy speaks exclusively with NBC News' Richard Engel. Zelenskyy talks about what he would advocate for if he were present at the meeting and why he thinks sanctions against Russia are crucial to ending the war.

headlines.title: President Trump lands in China for critical talks with Xi and Putin
headlines.description: Donald Trump arrives in China ahead of historic three-way talks with Russian President Vladimir Putin and Chinese President Xi Jinping. NBC News' Garrett Haake has the latest details on what to expect.

headlines.title: Jeffries says House Democrats will 'fight for an affordable America'
headlines.description: Rep. Hakeem Jeffries, D-N.Y., delivered remarks after being voted as his party's nominee to serve as the next speaker of the House. Jeffries discussed how he will "fight for an affordable America" and that "the status quo is unacceptable."

headlines.title: Nvidia board does not intend to reinstate Jensen Huang, chairman says
headlines.description: The Nvidia board "does not intend to reinstate" Jensen Huang as CEO, the newly appointed board chair, Harvey Jones, said on their quarterly earnings call. NBC News' Allie Canal and Sahil Kapur discuss how Nvidia topped estimates despite Huang's ouster.

headlines.title: Anthropic is about to be worth more than $1 trillion. What that means for the rest of us.
headlines.description: Leading AI lab Anthropic is expected to make the largest-ever public market debut when it starts trading on the Nasdaq stock exchange Thursday.

headlines.title: After 13 years, ‘Grand Theft Auto’ is back. Here’s what to know about the new game.
headlines.description: Between spikes in vacation day requests and college professors reportedly granting extensions to their students, the Thursday release of Grand Theft Auto VI could bring America (or the world) to a halt.

headlines.title: NASA Voyager Reaches One Full Light Day From Earth
headlines.description: After 49 years of traveling in space, NASA’s unmanned Voyager spacecraft has become the first human object to reach a full light day from Earth, meaning it would take a full 24 hours to reach the spacecraft traveling at the speed of light — 670 million miles per hour! NBC’s Tom Costello reports for TODAY on the spacecraft’s remarkable journey.

headlines.title: Highlights from Pope Leo’s historic, 12-day tour of South America
headlines.description: They turned out in their millions to greet Pope Leo as he made his way around Uruguay, Argentina and Peru on a gruelling 12-day tour of the South America.

headlines.title: 2026 Rockefeller Center Christmas Tree Arrives in New York City
headlines.description: A magnificent Norway spruce has made its journey from West Edmeston, New York, to Rockefeller Center. The tree will undergo a glow-up ahead of the lighting ceremony on Dec. 2.

headlines.title: Man accused of attacking Northwestern student followed others from train to dorms
headlines.description: A man who is accused of attempting to strangle a Northwestern University student in her dorm room got into the building after following two other students to the campus from the train, prosecutors said.

headlines.title: School AI system mistook Doritos for a gun, leading to teens’ terrifying police encounter
headlines.description: A group of Black teenagers said in a lawsuit that they were handcuffed and searched by Baltimore police officers outside their high school after an AI surveillance system mistook a bag of potato chips for a gun.
